concept.core_mechanic: Holding Space spends marker ink to paint a red boost road directly behind your car while you steer. Release Space while still on your fresh ink to launch forward, so the fastest line is a road you just drew — but the blue car can steal a ride on it too.
concept.juice: Red and blue paper-skid trails, yellow star sparkles on gate boosts, ink splats when marker paint lands, cone bounce and spin with a tiny screen shake on car-to-car bumps, speed lines at boost speed, squash-and-stretch cars when they hit the track edge, and big floating text that pops in for LAP 2! and FINAL LAP!.
concept.lose: The blue car finishes three laps first and the on-screen text says: "BLUE WINS! TRY AGAIN!"
concept.pitch: Race the red No. 5 car around a hand-drawn paper track and beat the blue No. 8 to the trophy in three laps.

roles.role: The player's big red No. 5 race car, shown top-down and rotating as it steers around the paper track.
The blue No. 8 rival car, racing the same three laps on its own fast line.
The gold trophy prize displayed huge at track center and awarded to the winner after three laps.
Short orange track cones that spin away and slow either car when clipped.
The taller orange pylon marking a narrow boost gate on each lap.
The marker pickup that refills the player's ink meter for painting boost roads.
The start/finish flag at the lap line, waving each time a car completes a lap.

concept.title: Paper Grand Prix
concept.win: Finish three laps before the blue car and the on-screen text says: "YOU WIN THE TROPHY!"
